 -versus-
 State of Odisha ...

Opposite Party
 Mr. A. Pradhan, Addl. Pp
 Coram:
 Justice G. Satapathy
 Order

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is an application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Township P.S. Case No.41 of 2024 corresponding to C.T.(S) Case No.153 of 2024 pending in the file of learned Ad-hoc Addl. District & Sessions Judge (FTSC), Angul for commission of offences punishable under Sections 450/376(2)(n) of the IPC, on the main allegation of committing rape upon the victim by breaking upon her door.

3. Heard, Mr. Asutosh Tripathy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. A. Pradhan, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offence as alleged against the petitioner and regard being had to the statement of the victim and on going through the materials placed on record in entirety, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.

5. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
(G. Satapathy) Judge S.Sasmal Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 12-Mar-2025 14:06:12 Kari @ Bharat Tiria vs State Of Odisha ...
